facts.fact: The Chambers guide, written by a law firm, cites Law No 15/2004 regulating e-signatures and establishing ITIDA as part of Egypt's framework and states what it requires of applicants for e-signature services; no date for the statement is given, so the publication date is used.

The Chambers guide states that Law No 15/2004 on e-signatures has executive regulations under which applicants for e-signature services must keep a secure system preserving confidentiality of customers' data; no date is given, so the publication date is used.
